title: GDC Weather
description: GDC weather station — live conditions (Prometheus) and history (InfluxDB).

list.name: period
list.label: Window
list.description: Aggregation window for min / mean / max / percentiles. auto = fits the time range.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Outdoor air temperature. Sparkline: last 24 h.

panels.title: Feels like
panels.description: Heat index. Orange ≥ 32 °C extreme caution, red ≥ 41 °C danger, dark red ≥ 54 °C extreme danger (NWS).

panels.title: Humidity
panels.description: Relative humidity.

panels.title: Wind
panels.description: Latest wind speed.

panels.title: Gust · 10 min
panels.description: Highest gust in the last 10 minutes. Yellow ≥ 22 kn strong breeze, orange ≥ 34 gale, red ≥ 48 storm.

panels.title: Direction
panels.description: Direction the wind is coming from.

panels.title: Wet bulb
panels.description: Lowest temperature evaporative cooling (pads, misting, cooling towers) can bring air down to. Yellow ≥ 24 °C, orange ≥ 27 °C (evaporative cooling weak), red ≥ 30 °C.

panels.title: Dew point
panels.description: Any surface colder than this gets wet: chilled pipes, cold-aisle walls, hydro-cooling plates.

panels.title: Dew-point margin
panels.description: Air temperature minus dew point. Red < 2 °C, orange < 4 °C: air near saturation, condensation and mist on equipment likely. Miners are rated for non-condensing humidity.

panels.title: Dust risk
panels.description: From the 10-min gust: Watch ≥ 15 kn, High ≥ 22 kn; one step lower when humidity is above 70 % (damp ground lifts less dust). On High: check intake filters and close dampers.

panels.title: Cooling conditions
panels.description: Mean per window. Air = what air-cooled miners breathe. Wet bulb = the floor for evaporative cooling. Dew point = surfaces below it sweat. Dashed grey line: wet bulb 27 °C.

targets.query:
s_air = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "temp")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (r._value - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Air")

s_wet_bulb = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "wet_bulb")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (r._value - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Wet bulb")

s_dew_point = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "dew_point")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (r._value - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Dew point")

union(tables: [s_air, s_wet_bulb, s_dew_point])
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Hours ≥ 35 °C
panels.description: Hours in the selected range with an hourly mean air temperature of 35 °C or more. Inside a container that is about 40 °C, the usual top of a miner's operating range: expect fans at full speed and derating.

panels.title: Cooling tower · approach & range

import "math"

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({u: r.wind_speed_last * math.sin(x: float(v: r.wind_dir_last) * math.pi / 180.0), v: r.wind_speed_last * math.cos(x: float(v: r.wind_dir_last) * math.pi / 180.0)}))
  |> reduce(identity: {u: 0.0, v: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({u: accumulator.u + r.u, v: accumulator.v + r.v}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      d = math.atan2(y: r.u, x: r.v) * 180.0 / math.pi
      deg = if d < 0.0 then d + 360.0 else d
